note: The pig these scripts and tests target: the same major.minor, at least this patch. Raise it with the SDK bump (scripts/pig-bin.mjs). `release` pins the public PiG release CI downloads (scripts/fetch-pig.mjs) and the source commit its Piglet builds need; the sha256 values are the release's SHA256SUMS, checked against a download of each archive. PiG v0.7.0 is tagged (commit beb56447c476) but its GitHub release carries only the source archives so far: `published` is false and `assets` stays empty until the release has pig archives and its SHA256SUMS can be recorded (node scripts/pin-pig-release.mjs 0.7.0), so scripts/fetch-pig.mjs refuses to download a pig until then; Piglet builds use the source checkout at `commit`.
